label: Fermi level from doping
subgoals: Write the majority density as ni times an exponential of the Fermi offset
Solve for the offset as kT times the natural log of N over ni
Assign the sign: above Ei for n-type, below for p-type

label: Doping from a Fermi level
subgoals: Divide the Fermi offset by kT
Express the density in the requested power of ten

label: Distance from the band edge
subgoals: Write the electron density with the conduction-band density of states
Solve for Ec minus EF as kT ln(Nc/ND)
Flag degeneracy when the doping approaches Nc
